_comment: Boccapioppo's entry on the travel map, and its look (docs/locations/river_town.md). Off the travel map until its reveal flag is set by Monteforchetta's bus line (the flag is to be agreed with that session); tests reach it with --island=river_town.
name: Boccapioppo
desc: A brick town where a clear Alpine river meets the Po, still mopping up after the flood. Poplars, bicycles and a levee warden who knows the river to the centimetre.

meter.name: Flood gauge
meter.about: Ermes repainted his river gauge at the flood's peak, 7.40 m. Every request you finish in Boccapioppo brings the reading down: a metre for the big ones, half a metre for the others, ten centimetres for each lost thing back home. At 0.00 m the flood is truly over.

milestones.title: Down a metre. Don't get excited.
milestones.desc: Ermes chalks the new reading on his door.

milestones.title: The river's back in its bed.
milestones.desc: The mooring plot is yours: a strip of bank beside the backwater to build on.

milestones.title: Halfway, give or take a centimetre.
milestones.desc: Primo found the plans for a streetlight and an electric lamp under a drying wheel.

milestones.title: The ducks are back. Well, the coypus.
milestones.desc: The mooring plot grows into a garden with a jetty out over the backwater.

milestones.title: The flood is over.
milestones.desc: Zero on the gauge. Ermes paints over the high-water mark himself.
